CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "position" (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS position_tech (
    position_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "position"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tech_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (position_id, tech_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS position_course (
    position_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "position"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (position_id, course_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_position_name ON "position"(name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_position_tech_position_id ON position_tech(position_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_position_tech_tech_id ON position_tech(tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_position_course_position_id ON position_course(position_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_position_course_course_id ON position_course(course_id);
